158     def _filter_content_by_names(
159         self,
160         parsed_response: dict,
161         keys: Union[str, bool, Sequence[str]],
162         allow_missing: bool = False,
163     ) -> Union[str, dict, None]:
164         """Filter the parsed response by keys. If only one key is provided, the
165         returned content will be a single corresponding value. Otherwise,
166         the returned content will be a dictionary with the filtered keys and
167         their corresponding values.
168 
169         Args:
170             keys (`Union[str, bool, Sequence[str]]`):
171                 The key or keys to be filtered. If it's
172                 - `False`, `None` will be returned in the `to_content` method
173                 - `str`, the corresponding value will be returned
174                 - `List[str]`, a filtered dictionary will be returned
175                 - `True`, the whole dictionary will be returned
176             allow_missing (`bool`, defaults to `False`):
177                 Whether to allow missing keys in the response. If set to
178                 `True`, the method will skip the missing keys in the response.
179                 Otherwise, it will raise a `ValueError` when a key is missing.
180 
181         Returns:
182             `Union[str, dict]`: The filtered content.
183         """
184 
185         if isinstance(keys, bool):
186             if keys:
187                 return parsed_response
188             else:
189                 return None
190 
191         if isinstance(keys, str):
192             return parsed_response[keys]
193 
194         # check if the required names are in the response
195         for name in keys:
196             if name not in parsed_response:
197                 if allow_missing:
198                     logger.warning(
199                         f"Content name {name} not found in the response. Skip "
200                         f"it.",
201                     )
202                 else:
203                     raise ValueError(f"Name {name} not found in the response.")
204         return {
205             name: parsed_response[name]
206             for name in keys
207             if name in parsed_response
208         }

78     """A mixin class to filter the parsed response by keys. It allows users
79     to set keys to be filtered during speaking, storing in memory, and
80     returning in the agent reply function.
81     """
82 
83     def __init__(
84         self,
85         keys_to_memory: Union[str, bool, Sequence[str]],
86         keys_to_content: Union[str, bool, Sequence[str]],
87         keys_to_metadata: Union[str, bool, Sequence[str]],
88     ) -> None:
89         """Initialize the mixin class with the keys to be filtered during
90         speaking, storing in memory, and returning in the agent reply function.
91 
92         Args:
93             keys_to_memory (`Optional[Union[str, bool, Sequence[str]]]`):
94                 The key or keys to be filtered in `to_memory` method. If
95                 it's
96                 - `False`, `None` will be returned in the `to_memory` method
97                 - `str`, the corresponding value will be returned
98                 - `List[str]`, a filtered dictionary will be returned
99                 - `True`, the whole dictionary will be returned
100             keys_to_content (`Optional[Union[str, bool, Sequence[str]]`):
101                 The key or keys to be filtered in `to_content` method. If
102                 it's
103                 - `False`, `None` will be returned in the `to_content` method
104                 - `str`, the corresponding value will be returned
105                 - `List[str]`, a filtered dictionary will be returned
106                 - `True`, the whole dictionary will be returned
107             keys_to_metadata (`Optional[Union[str, bool, Sequence[str]]]`):
108                 The key or keys to be filtered in `to_metadata` method. If
109                 it's
110                 - `False`, `None` will be returned in the `to_metadata` method
111                 - `str`, the corresponding value will be returned
112                 - `List[str]`, a filtered dictionary will be returned
113                 - `True`, the whole dictionary will be returned
114         """
115         self.keys_to_memory = keys_to_memory
116         self.keys_to_content = keys_to_content
117         self.keys_to_metadata = keys_to_metadata
118 
119     def to_memory(
120         self,
121         parsed_response: dict,
122         allow_missing: bool = False,
123     ) -> Union[str, dict, None]:
124         """Filter the fields that will be stored in memory."""
125         return self._filter_content_by_names(
126             parsed_response,
127             self.keys_to_memory,
128             allow_missing=allow_missing,
129         )
130 
131     def to_content(
132         self,
133         parsed_response: dict,
134         allow_missing: bool = False,
135     ) -> Union[str, dict, None]:
136         """Filter the fields that will be fed into the content field in the
137         returned message, which will be exposed to other agents.
138         """
139         return self._filter_content_by_names(
140             parsed_response,
141             self.keys_to_content,
142             allow_missing=allow_missing,
143         )
144 
145     def to_metadata(
146         self,
147         parsed_response: dict,
148         allow_missing: bool = False,
149     ) -> Union[str, dict, None]:
150         """Filter the fields that will be fed into the returned message
151         directly to control the application workflow."""
152         return self._filter_content_by_names(
153             parsed_response,
154             self.keys_to_metadata,
155             allow_missing=allow_missing,
156         )

22     """werewolf game"""
23     # default settings
24     HostMsg = partial(Msg, name="Moderator", role="assistant", echo=True)
25     healing, poison = True, True
26     MAX_WEREWOLF_DISCUSSION_ROUND = 3
27     MAX_GAME_ROUND = 6
28     # read model and agent configs, and initialize agents automatically
29     survivors = agentscope.init(
30         model_configs="./configs/model_configs.json",
31         agent_configs="./configs/agent_configs.json",
32     )
33 
34     roles = ["werewolf", "werewolf", "villager", "villager", "seer", "witch"]
35     wolves, witch, seer = survivors[:2], survivors[-1], survivors[-2]
36 
37     # start the game
38     for _ in range(1, MAX_GAME_ROUND + 1):
39         # night phase, werewolves discuss
40         hint = HostMsg(content=Prompts.to_wolves.format(n2s(wolves)))
41         with msghub(wolves, announcement=hint) as hub:
42             set_parsers(wolves, Prompts.wolves_discuss_parser)
43             for _ in range(MAX_WEREWOLF_DISCUSSION_ROUND):
44                 x = sequentialpipeline(wolves)
45                 if x.metadata.get("finish_discussion", False):
46                     break
47 
48             set_parsers(wolves, Prompts.wolves_vote_parser)
49             # werewolves vote
50             hint = HostMsg(content=Prompts.to_wolves_vote)
51             votes = [
52                 extract_name_and_id(wolf(hint).content)[0] for wolf in wolves
53             ]
54             # broadcast the result to werewolves
55             dead_player = [majority_vote(votes)]
56             hub.broadcast(
57                 HostMsg(content=Prompts.to_wolves_res.format(dead_player[0])),
58             )
59 
60         # witch
61         healing_used_tonight = False
62         if witch in survivors:
63             if healing:
64                 hint = HostMsg(
65                     content=Prompts.to_witch_resurrect.format_map(
66                         {
67                             "witch_name": witch.name,
68                             "dead_name": dead_player[0],
69                         },
70                     ),
71                 )
72                 set_parsers(witch, Prompts.witch_resurrect_parser)
73                 if witch(hint).metadata.get("resurrect", False):
74                     healing_used_tonight = True
75                     dead_player.pop()
76                     healing = False
77                     HostMsg(content=Prompts.to_witch_resurrect_yes)
78                 else:
79                     HostMsg(content=Prompts.to_witch_resurrect_no)
80 
81             if poison and not healing_used_tonight:
82                 set_parsers(witch, Prompts.witch_poison_parser)
83                 x = witch(HostMsg(content=Prompts.to_witch_poison))
84                 if x.metadata.get("eliminate", False):
85                     dead_player.append(extract_name_and_id(x.content)[0])
86                     poison = False
87 
88         # seer
89         if seer in survivors:
90             hint = HostMsg(
91                 content=Prompts.to_seer.format(seer.name, n2s(survivors)),
92             )
93             set_parsers(seer, Prompts.seer_parser)
94             x = seer(hint)
95 
96             player, idx = extract_name_and_id(x.content)
97             role = "werewolf" if roles[idx] == "werewolf" else "villager"
98             hint = HostMsg(content=Prompts.to_seer_result.format(player, role))
99             seer.observe(hint)
100 
101         survivors, wolves = update_alive_players(
102             survivors,
103             wolves,
104             dead_player,
105         )
106         if check_winning(survivors, wolves, "Moderator"):
107             break
108 
109         # daytime discussion
110         content = (
111             Prompts.to_all_danger.format(n2s(dead_player))
112             if dead_player
113             else Prompts.to_all_peace
114         )
115         hints = [
116             HostMsg(content=content),
117             HostMsg(content=Prompts.to_all_discuss.format(n2s(survivors))),
118         ]
119         with msghub(survivors, announcement=hints) as hub:
120             # discuss
121             set_parsers(survivors, Prompts.survivors_discuss_parser)
122             x = sequentialpipeline(survivors)
123 
124             set_parsers(survivors, Prompts.survivors_vote_parser)
125             # vote

127             votes = [
128                 extract_name_and_id(_(hint).content)[0] for _ in survivors
129             ]
130             vote_res = majority_vote(votes)
131             # broadcast the result to all players
132             result = HostMsg(content=Prompts.to_all_res.format(vote_res))
133             hub.broadcast(result)
134 
135             survivors, wolves = update_alive_players(
136                 survivors,
137                 wolves,
138                 vote_res,
139             )
140

142                 break
143 
144             hub.broadcast(HostMsg(content=Prompts.to_all_continue))
